media.alt: An 18 second text reel from Ellenton Family Practice Direct, logo at the top and familypracticedirect.com at the foot throughout. Flu shots, this season: three things the CDC says. Who: everyone 6 months and older, with rare exceptions, a flu vaccine every season. When: September and October, ideally by the end of October. How long: about two weeks after a flu shot to build protection. It ends on Ask about availability when you call, with an amber Call 941 417 7386 button.
